verdicts.reason: A is a cramped jumble. 'with your next cup of coffee' is nearly as large as 'GET A GIFT', so the headline has no clear priority. 'Only this Christmas' runs into the edge of the sweater photo, the oversized stars float apart from the copy, and the logo, headline and URL are crowded against the left edge with uneven gaps. B has a clearer hierarchy: the headline is clearly dominant and the copy has more breathing room. It still has flaws a designer must fix: the URL and 'Only this Christmas' are tiny at banner size, the divider lines are placed arbitrarily and don't line up, and the stars are too big for the line they decorate.
